_note: One file per saved search; the filename (without .json) is the search's source label. Input schema = the harvestapi/linkedin-job-search Apify actor. 'locations' takes plain place names (LinkedIn understands 'Madrid', 'Spain', 'San Francisco') — no geoId needed. Use 'United Kingdom' rather than 'UK'. A numeric 'geoIds' is optional precision. Copy this file to e.g. searches/barcelona.json and edit. Your real searches are git-ignored; only searches/example-*.json are tracked.
